page.layout: One page: a circular engraved coat of arms with a legend running around the circle. No running text, page number, running head or catchword.

main_text.l: SCVLPSIT IN INVIDIEM DIRVTA ROMA TVAM

page.notes: Engraving, not text: a coat of arms in a circular frame with a double ring border. The shield shows two lions passant (one above the other) and small rectangular charges, under a helm with crest and mantling, flanked by scrolled acanthus ornaments. The legend is printed around the outer ring, reading clockwise from the top after a small ornament. Line breaks above follow the legend's reading order and are approximate. Hyphens and punctuation of the legend, including the comma after LEONES, are as they appear. A faint watermark "Digitized by Google" appears at the lower right and is excluded.
